audience.en: A 32-year-old French registered nurse (IDE) in Annecy, single, earning about €2,450 net a month, deciding whether to take a Geneva hospital nursing job from mid-2027 and commute across the border.
audience.fr: Une infirmière française (IDE) de 32 ans à Annecy, célibataire, qui gagne environ 2 450 € nets par mois et se demande si elle doit accepter un poste d'infirmière dans un hôpital genevois à partir de la mi-2027 en faisant la navette à travers la frontière.

localeReason: English and French both serve this decision. The person is a French nurse living in Annecy who would deal with Swiss and French authorities, the Swiss Red Cross, Geneva payroll, LAMal and French tax forms; French lets her read the conditions, the stress test and the open issues in her own language, and it changes no rule, rate or figure.

planningAssumptions.profile: French registered nurse (IDE), 32, single, Annecy, about €2,450 net a month today; job start from mid-2027 (1 July 2027 in the French-option example).
planningAssumptions.pay: Geneva State scale from 1 January 2026, class 15 assumed (unconfirmed, from upreer.ch), step 1 and step 5 (CHF 95,260); 13th month not assumed; 2027 scale not published.
planningAssumptions.deductions: AVS/AI/APG 5.3% and AC 1.1% (federal page via search snippet); pension plus accident 9% and source tax 10% are placeholders.
planningAssumptions.health: LAMal 2026 median CHF 489.30 for France residents, age 26+, CHF 300 deductible, no accident cover; French option example uses the 2026 Social Security ceiling (48,060) and an assumed 2025 income of €29,400.
planningAssumptions.fx: ECB reference 2026-11-06: 1 EUR = 0.9143 CHF, 1 CHF = 1.0937 EUR.
planningAssumptions.commute: 45 km one way, 6 L/100 km, €1.80 a litre, 17 commute days a month, ADELAC toll €9.40 one way, parking CHF 91.90 a month as a placeholder; no Léman Pass price.

datePolicy: All sources were read on 2026-11-08 in the original run and that access date is kept; page dates (for example the OCPM page updated 19 October 2026) and the ECB rate date are source dates, not access dates. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: Pension plus accident (9%) and Geneva source tax (10%) are unsourced placeholders and the largest uncertainty in the net figures; the stress test shows a 10-point error still leaves about €1,608 a month at step 1.

Class 15 for a generic staff IDE comes only from an unconfirmed site (upreer.ch); the 13th month is stated only by unconfirmed sites; the 2027 pay scale, the 2027 France-resident LAMal table and the 2027 Social Security ceiling are not published.
AVS/AI/APG 5.3% and AC 1.1% rest on a search snippet of the federal page; the table was not re-read.

No Léman Pass price for Annecy was found, so the train comparison is a break-even (below about €585 a month), not a price; the 1 h 30 train time is an unconfirmed snippet; TPG pass, Swiss vignette and French mileage allowance were not found.

Whether the French DE infirmier is in Annex V of Directive 2005/36/EC, the G permit fee, the issuer of the French good-standing certificate and the SRC language requirement were not verified; MEBEKO not being the nurse body rests on Geneva's page alone.
French-option example uses the 2026 ceiling and an assumed 2025 income of €29,400; the assumption of no extra French tax under Cas 2A needs an adviser.
